extracted.name: Bread dressing
ingredient_lines: 3 cups dry white bread (remove all crust,crumble into pieces)
instruction_lines: Mix all ingredients together,fry onion in little butter before adding to mixture, toss lightly with a fork to blend. For celery dressing use 1 cup chopped celery for 1 cup bread crumbs. Sufficient for one 5-pound fowl.
